supersedes_interpretation: RCG-002 v1 biological sensorimotor body framing is superseded; history and earlier evidence are retained unchanged
body: Qualified E-CPU observer-hosts, authenticated communication paths, in-transit realization, verifiable authority and durable session lineage
mind: Procedural synthetic neural/operator Grounds, verified representation changes, trained source-bound policies and task-relative computation navigation
connectome_role: Version-pinned heterogeneous graph topology for explicitly synthetic computational models; no biological dynamics or artificial organism claim

current_evidence.mathematical: RCG-005 local generated sparse graph n=1024, depth=6, 7 latent outputs, exact vector annihilator, nonlinear observable, time 2^56+73
current_evidence.training: RCG-003 synthetic path-cost regression only; RCG-005 nonlinear transformation parameters are generated, not learned
current_evidence.transport: RCG-004 native authenticated transport remains gated by hosted E-CPU CI; RCG-005 reuses its protocol and has not locally verified a physical remote network
current_evidence.persistence: RCG-002 Chronicle and E-CPU M1/M3 remain authorities; RCG-005 portable mathematical capsule has no independent trust domain

tracks.question: Can a learned compiler discover nontrivial invertible nonlinear encoders whose conjugated source operators still admit receiver-checkable compact vector certificates?
tracks.synthetic_training_data: Generate disjoint families of sparse operators, invertible polynomial coupling descriptions and deliberately nonconjugate/corrupted counterexamples
tracks.objective: Maximize held-out exact equivalence and usable nonlinear representation diversity per source byte and construction cost
tracks.promotion_gate: Receiver checks exact E(D(x)) and D(E(x)) through a symbolic algebraic certificate or complete finite-domain proof, and full-vector q(M)e0=0; short sampled agreement is not enough

tracks.question: Can path selection adapt to changing real host latency and availability while preserving Ground and authority?
tracks.synthetic_training_data: Known-bounded workloads with declared service queue perturbations; measurements are the actual E-CPU mTLS sender/receiver spans, not the injected delay label
tracks.objective: Minimize verified complete intention latency and source/receipt transfer bytes; refuse unqualified routes
tracks.promotion_gate: Native E-CPU TLS peer identity, original source pin, full application receipt, transport and task correctness verified on withheld host states
metrics: regret to held-out best eligible route

tracks.question: Can distinct observer-hosts realize different certified readouts of a shared neural Ground and compose an exact nonlinear result after a host is replaced?
tracks.synthetic_training_data: RCG-005 source-anchored synthetic time navigation workloads varying operator dimension, requested latent count, nonlinear depth and log-time
tracks.objective: Increase useful mathematically distinct demanded functions without repeating full-domain or full-history evaluation
baseline: direct source iteration on short horizons
tracks.promotion_gate: Every readout is returned by an authenticated receiver and independently verified; receipt set binds one model revision and logical coordinate; changed source, request or peer refuses

tracks.question: Can a verified source/model certificate and stateful receiver session migrate after a hard kill without duplicated semantic effects?
tracks.synthetic_training_data: Original source pins, RCG-002 Chronicle high-water, E-CPU M1 object pages, M3 checkpoint lineage, independent process kill cuts and recovered requests
tracks.objective: Preserve the same model, task coordinate and proof authority while hosts and implementation change
baseline: E-CPU M3 native session checkpoint recovery
tracks.promotion_gate: Two independently authenticated receiver lifetimes, quorum-current lineage and explicit no-replay effect evidence; do not substitute a hash for authority

tracks.question: Which nonlinear network descriptions are equivalent under an explicitly selected observation contract, and which require more evidence?
tracks.synthetic_training_data: Families of different but observationally equivalent reversible charts, changed synthetic kernels and delayed counterexamples
tracks.objective: Learn useful equivalence proposals and compressed capability atlas, with VGI proof/refusal as the authority
tracks.promotion_gate: Test adversarial changed Ground and hidden-mode counterexamples; any unproved equivalence stays unresolved
